tokenName: The Post Office Commodity-Backed Warehouse Token
underlyingAsset: England state enterprise commodity receipt — mineral ore / agricultural produce stored at certified government warehousing facility
description: The Post Office issues warehouse receipt tokens backed by commodities produced or procured by the enterprise. Token holders receive pro-rata claims on certified stored inventory, enabling smallholder suppliers to access immediate liquidity.
regulatoryFramework: Companies Act 2006; FCA Crypto Asset Registration Framework

tokenName: The Post Office Workforce Service Contract Token
underlyingAsset: England public sector service contract — vetted suppliers, maintenance contractors and consultants engaged by The Post Office
description: The Post Office tokenises service contracts with suppliers and independent contractors. Micro-enterprises and artisans can tokenise outstanding invoices as collateral for working-capital loans, eliminating the 90-day government payment delay.
regulatoryFramework: Companies Act 2006; FCA Crypto Asset Registration Framework

tokenName: The Post Office Infrastructure PPP Token
underlyingAsset: Public-private partnership project in England — managed by The Post Office with mandatory 60% local employment quota
description: The Post Office issues PPP tokens for capital infrastructure projects. Each token represents fractional participation in project revenue under a concession agreement. Smart contracts automatically enforce local hiring targets before milestone payments are released.
regulatoryFramework: Companies Act 2006; FCA Crypto Asset Registration Framework

tokenName: The Post Office Public Real Estate Asset Token
underlyingAsset: Government-owned land and property portfolio managed by The Post Office in England
description: The Post Office tokenises government property assets to unlock dormant balance-sheet value. Citizens can invest from 1 GBP unit and earn rental income proportional to token holdings, converting public assets into inclusive wealth-generation instruments.
regulatoryFramework: Companies Act 2006; FCA Crypto Asset Registration Framework

tokenName: The Post Office Verified Labour Proof-of-Work Token
underlyingAsset: Daily economic activity of casual workers, contract staff and micro-vendors contracted by The Post Office
description: The Post Office issues proof-of-work tokens for every verified day of labour performed by casual workers on government contracts. Accumulated tokens build a portable credit score accepted by partner lenders, replacing the collateral requirement for the unbanked workforce.
regulatoryFramework: Companies Act 2006; FCA Crypto Asset Registration Framework

tokenName: The Post Office Capital Project Milestone Token
underlyingAsset: Construction and development project milestones verified by independent engineers at The Post Office projects in England
description: The Post Office issues milestone tokens that unlock progress payments only when independent inspectors verify project completion at each gate. This eliminates corruption in public procurement and ensures employment-creating contractors are paid promptly and fairly.
regulatoryFramework: Companies Act 2006; FCA Crypto Asset Registration Framework

tokenName: The Post Office Agricultural Offtake Token
underlyingAsset: Smallholder and commercial farm produce procured by The Post Office under government off-take programmes in England
description: The Post Office tokenises forward purchase agreements with smallholder farmers who supply the enterprise. Farmers receive pre-season financing in token form, redeemable at harvest. This removes predatory middlemen and connects subsistence farmers to institutional buyers.
regulatoryFramework: Companies Act 2006; FCA Crypto Asset Registration Framework

tokenName: The Post Office SME Supply Chain Participation Token
underlyingAsset: Small and medium enterprise contracts awarded by The Post Office under preferential procurement policies in England
description: The Post Office tokenises the economic value of SME contracts under its preferential procurement programme. Tokens can be listed on the national digital exchange, enabling impact investors to co-fund local businesses while earning competitive returns.
regulatoryFramework: Companies Act 2006; FCA Crypto Asset Registration Framework

tokenName: The Post Office SOE Diversified Portfolio ETF Token
underlyingAsset: Diversified exposure to all tokenised assets across The Post Office enterprise operations in England
description: The Post Office launches a basket ETF token spanning all 15 tokenised asset classes within its operations. A single token gives retail investors diversified exposure to infrastructure, commodities, labor, SME supply chains and government bonds from 1 GBP unit.

tokenName: The Post Office Partial State Equity Token

tokenName: The Post Office SOE Development Bond Token

description: The Post Office tokenises government-guaranteed development bonds accessible from 1 GBP unit. Proceeds finance electrification, water, transport or ICT expansion projects. Quarterly coupon payments are streamed directly to token holders' wallets in real time.

tokenName: The Post Office Universal Access Financial Inclusion Token

tokenName: The Post Office Critical Mineral Royalty Token

description: The Post Office mints an agriculture proof-of-work token for each independently verified farming event — planting, cultivation and harvest — recorded by satellite and IoT sensors. Verified records build a formal credit identity for smallholder farmers with no prior banking history.

description: The Post Office tokenises every custody transfer and logistics event across its supply chain on an immutable ledger. Each step earns employment tokens for transport operators and warehouse workers, creating a traceable, tamper-proof record from source to end consumer.
